archetypes.name: dyn-bash-jobcontrol
archetypes.rationale: redirect change touches subtle set -m job-control, FD inheritance, and process-group teardown semantics
archetypes.prompt_body: Scrutinize the widened stderr redirect in design-step3-review.sh's monitor-mode critical section. Verify that wrapping the background launch, wait, and teardown in a `{ ...; } 2>log` group did not change `$!`/`_loop_pid` capture, process-group isolation, or `kill -- -$pid` teardown. Confirm the plan-review loop's own `2>` redirect correctly routes its (and inherited reviewer children's) stderr to the dedicated log without dropping data normalize-status consumes (stdout-file + loop-rc). Check that set +e/set -e and the EXIT-trap reassignment ordering (#4724 atomicity) are preserved and that bash 3.2 semantics hold. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
